setup_error_load: Kemlock's background didn't answer. Reload this tab, or restart the browser.
setup_password_lead: This password opens the Kemlock vault in this browser. It is apart from your phone's password: your phone's items arrive through sync.
setup_password_forgot: Nothing can recover this password. If you forget it, remove Kemlock from this browser and set it up again with the same sync: every item comes back.
setup_password_footnote: Your password never leaves this computer.
setup_password_sealing: Sealing your vault. This takes a moment on purpose: slow key derivation is what makes guessing expensive.
setup_unlock_lead: Setup needs the vault open to join a sync place.
setup_unlock_wrong: Wrong password. {count} wrong tries since the vault last opened.
setup_place_lead: Join the place your phone already uses, so this browser holds the same codes and logins.
setup_place_current: Now syncing with {place}: {server}. The browser keeps its items, and nothing is removed from there.
setup_place_kemlock_body: Your Kemlock account on a Kemlock Server.
setup_place_webdav_body: A folder on your own WebDAV server, opened with your sync passphrase.
setup_place_vaultwarden_body: The Kemlock home in your Vaultwarden account.
setup_place_phone: Your phone shows where it syncs under Settings › Sync.
setup_address_lead: Type the address you use to reach it. Only https addresses are accepted.
setup_address_lead_folder: Type the address of the WebDAV folder your phone syncs with. Only https addresses are accepted.
setup_address_invalid: That isn't an address. Type one like https://vault.example.
setup_address_certificate: Your computer must trust the server's certificate. This browser can't use a certificate your phone has pinned.
setup_certificate_hint: If your computer doesn't trust the server's certificate, open the address in a browser tab to see why.
setup_access_lead: Kemlock asks the browser for access to {host} so it can sync with it.
setup_access_nothing: Nothing is sent to {host} until you allow it.
setup_access_apart: This is apart from the optional access to all sites that the buttons in fields on pages need.
setup_access_refused: Sync needs access to {host}, so setup can't go on without it. Nothing was sent.
setup_form_lead_kemlock: Use your Kemlock account. This browser becomes one of its devices.
setup_form_lead_webdav: The username and password your WebDAV server asks for, and the sync passphrase your phone uses for this folder.
setup_form_lead_vaultwarden: Use your Vaultwarden account. This browser shows up there as a device.
setup_form_master_kemlock: It signs you in and is never stored. This browser's own password stays what you set before.
setup_form_master_vaultwarden: It opens your account's key in this browser and is never kept.
setup_form_passphrase_hint: The passphrase that seals the sync file. Setup joins only when it opens the file.
setup_form_busy: Signing in. Opening the key can take a few seconds.
setup_form_passkey: Use a passkey or security key
setup_form_busy_sso: Finish signing in in the window that opened.
setup_form_busy_passkey: Touch your passkey or security key in the window that opened.
setup_way_sso_cancelled: The SSO sign-in was cancelled. Nothing was changed.
setup_way_passkey_cancelled: The passkey was not used. Nothing was changed.
setup_way_sso_failed: The SSO sign-in didn't finish. Try again.
setup_way_passkey_failed: The passkey page didn't give an answer. Try again.
setup_way_unsupported: This server doesn't offer that way of signing in.
setup_sso_refused: This server doesn't list this extension, so it can't end an SSO sign-in here. Ask its administrator to add this extension's id to KEMLOCK_BROWSER_EXTENSION_IDS: {id}
setup_logins_stay: Logins aren't synced with Vaultwarden yet: they stay in this browser. Sync them through WebDAV.
setup_second_lead: Your account asks for a second step to sign in.
setup_second_methods: How do you want to sign in?
setup_method_authenticator_hint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
setup_method_email_hint: The code the server emailed to your account's address.
setup_method_yubikey_hint: Click the field, then touch your YubiKey.
setup_method_apiKey_hint: Your account's personal API key (client secret), from its settings in the web vault.
setup_second_duo: Duo can't be done in the browser. Sign in with your personal API key instead.
setup_second_email_send: Choose “Send the code”: the server emails it to your account's address.
setup_second_email_sent: The code was sent to your account's email address.
setup_second_remember_hint: The next sign-in skips this step.
setup_key_lead: Kemlock opens a page of your server in a new tab. Touch your security key there. The tab closes by itself.
setup_key_asking: Touch your security key in the tab that opened.
setup_key_closed: The tab was closed before the key answered. Try again.
setup_key_unavailable: This server can't ask a security key from the browser. Pick another method, or use your personal API key.
setup_key_other: Your server's own address is {address}, which isn't the one you typed. A security key only answers on the server's own address, so start again with it.
setup_approval_lead: Open Kemlock on a device where you are signed in and approve this browser. It must show the same five words.
setup_approval_check: If the words differ, don't approve: someone else may be signing in.
setup_master_lead: No signed-in device is here to approve this browser, so your master password opens the account's key. It isn't stored.
setup_homes_lead: Your Vaultwarden account holds these Kemlock homes. Pick the one your phone uses. Setup can't make a home.
setup_home_sealed_note: This home is sealed: its passphrase comes next.
setup_home_plain_warning: This home is plain: anyone who gets into your Vaultwarden account has both factors. No passphrase is asked.
setup_nohome_lead: Turn on Vaultwarden sync in Kemlock on your phone first, then come back here.
setup_passphrase_lead_folder: The passphrase your phone uses for this folder. Setup joins only when it opens the folder's sync file.
setup_passphrase_lead_home: This home is sealed. The passphrase is checked against its seal before anything syncs.
setup_first_lead: This is what the first sync with {place} will do. It hasn't run yet.
setup_first_removes_warning: Check that this is the place you meant before you go on: removed items can't be brought back from here.
setup_first_nothing: Nothing changes until you start the sync.
setup_done_lead: This browser is set up and synced.
setup_done_lead_alone: This browser has a vault of its own. You can join a sync place later by setting up again.
setup_next_pin: Pin Kemlock: click the puzzle-piece icon in the toolbar, then the pin beside Kemlock.
setup_next_open: Open Kemlock from the toolbar to see your codes and logins.
setup_next_sync: Kemlock syncs every five minutes while the vault is unlocked.
setup_next_hint: Click Kemlock's icon in the toolbar to open it.
setup_remove_deletes: It deletes this browser's vault and everything Kemlock stored here.
setup_remove_forgets: It forgets this browser's sign-in to your sync place.
setup_remove_keeps: Your phone and your sync place aren't touched, and nothing is deleted there.
setup_remove_recover: To get your items back later, set the browser up again with a new password and the same sync.
setup_removed_title: Kemlock was removed from this browser
setup_removed_lead: Nothing was deleted on your phone or in your sync place.
